name: half-adder
title: Half adder
description: S = A XOR B, C = A AND B. Two gates, one gate delay.

name: full-adder
title: Full adder (from half-adder chips)
description: Two half-adder chips and an OR gate. Cin -> Cout takes 2 gate delays.

name: 4-bit-adder
title: 4-bit ripple-carry adder
description: 4-bit ripple-carry adder from full-adder chips (which contain half-adder chips). The carry ripples through every stage, 2 gate delays each.

name: sr-latch
title: SR latch (NOR)
description: Cross-coupled NOR latch. S sets Q, R resets it, both low holds. Releasing S and R together from 1/1 is a race: the latch oscillates in the unit-delay model.

name: d-flip-flop
title: D flip-flop (master-slave, gates)
description: Master-slave positive-edge D flip-flop from NAND gates: the master latch is open while CLK is low, the slave while CLK is high, so Q only takes D on a rising edge.

name: 4-bit-counter
title: 4-bit counter + 7-segment
description: Synchronous 4-bit counter: bit i toggles when all lower bits are 1 (D = Q xor carry). Hold RST to clear it. The 7-segment display shows the count in hex.

name: 2-to-4-decoder
title: 2-to-4 decoder
description: Exactly one output goes high: the one selected by A1 A0, while EN is high.

name: 4-to-1-mux
title: 4:1 multiplexer
description: Y = D[S1 S0]: four AND-terms selected by the address lines, OR-ed together.

name: traffic-light
title: Traffic-light state machine
description: Moore state machine on two D flip-flops: GREEN (00) -> AMBER (01) -> RED (10) -> GREEN. It only leaves green while REQ is high.

name: ring-oscillator
title: Ring oscillator (unstable)
description: A NAND and four inverters in a loop: five inversions, so no stable state. Flip EN to 1 and the instability detector reports the loop and its period (2 x 5 = 10 ticks).
